caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a person shown in profile, facing left. The figure has dark brown skin and wears a white turban wrapped around the head, with five feathers sticking out from the top; the feathers are colored black, gray, and red with visible markings. The person has a prominent nose and lips, and the ear is adorned with a large oval blue earring. The person is draped in a textured, flowing garment colored bright red with deep shadows, and around the neck is a necklace made up of large, rounded beads colored green, blue, and red. The background of the drawing is plain and beige. The artist's signature appears in the lower right corner.
title: Wooden Indian Bust
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
